channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Nationalist Party flags unanswered questions over Maltas invitation to join Board of Peace
item.description: The PN's spokesperson for foreign affairs questions why Malta's invitation was 'informal,' and whether a possible membership would infringe on the country's neutrality

item.title: MFSA publishes a new general code of conduct for decision makers in the financial services industry
item.description: The MFSA has designed the Code to be applied in accordance with the principle of proportionality, providing a flexible and risk-based framework of principles rather than prescriptive rules

item.title: WATCH | The vital role of the internal audit profession to be highlighted in February conference
item.description: This event will provide participants with valuable insights into the regulator’s expectations of Boards, Audit Committees and internal auditors, as well as their collective contribution to maintaining sound and robust organisations

item.title: Tiny Sliema room advertised for €600 rent sparks criticism and mockery
item.description: Facebook users compared the room to a prison cell, as many noted that the room doesn’t have a window

item.title: MPs mark Holocaust Remembrance Day with warning to confront hatred before it turns into atrocity
item.description: Speakers in parliament said the Holocaust was the result of gradual choices and silence, urging society and politicians alike to recognise early signs of discrimination and defend minorities

item.title: Government plans to extend 24-hour service to two more health centres, minister tells MPs
item.description: Health Minister Jo Etienne Abela says increased funding for primary care will be used to expand round-the-clock services and extend opening hours at the Gozo health centre

item.title: Repubblika warns of ‘global democratic emergency’ at vigil over US immigration deaths
item.description: Repubblika president Vicki Ann Cremona said killings linked to immigration enforcement in the United States risk normalising cruelty and weakening the rule of law worldwide

item.title: Donald Trump’s Board of Peace: 7 reasons why Malta should not join
item.description: Morality aside, Malta faces strategic, financial, and diplomatic risks in joining Donald Trump’s Board of Peace. James Debono believes participation could compromise the national interest

item.title: Galdes, misplaced loyalties and accountability
item.description: It would seem the days of pro-active decision-making based on an expectation of political accountability have long vanished, which is a pity because this country deserves much better

item.title: Scabies cases surged in 2023
item.description: A significant increase in scabies, a skin infection caused by mites, was recorded three years ago, data tabled in parliament by Health Minister Jo Etienne Abela shows
